worldcombat.skill.octazooka.summary: Spray several bursts of ink in the target's face; each bolt that lands deals damage and about half the time the ink blinds it and cuts its accuracy.
worldcombat.skill.octazooka.use.0: A chained ink stream at close-to-mid range
worldcombat.skill.octazooka.use.1: Blind the target and cut its accuracy
Each bolt deals about %1$s special damage when it hits a foe, and %2$s bolts are sprayed; each hit has a %3$s chance to ink the foe's eyes and drop accuracy by %4$s stages, at most once per cast.
Bolts fly at %1$s up to %2$s blocks, spaced %3$s apart with a %4$s degree spread and a %5$s block hit radius.

Ink turns toward its target by up to %1$s degrees per tick; thick ink makes each bolt heavier and the blind chance higher, but sprays one fewer bolt with a longer interval and a longer wind-up and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.octazooka.timing: Range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.octazooka.preference.t: On: per-bolt power ×1.5 and +10% blind chance, but one fewer bolt, +2 ticks between bolts, +2 ticks wind-up and +4 ticks cooldown. Off: more, lighter bolts sprayed faster.
worldcombat.skill.octazooka.preference.a: Beyond this distance the companion closes in first. Larger values open with ink from further away.
On: it may leave a hold position to find a firing line. Off: it only sprays when already in range.
